    drawPolygonFill

    • drawPolygonFill(
          shapes: readonly (FeatureShape | null | undefined)[],
          arcs: ArcCollection,
          fillColor: string,
          filter?: (i: number) => boolean,
          opacity?: number,
          options?: PolygonFillOptions,
      ): void

      Draw a fill for polygon shapes in vertex edit mode.

      IMPORTANT: Must use getShapeIter (not getArcIter) so that reversed arcs (~arcId) are traversed backwards, preserving correct polygon winding order. This is what mapshaper does via ShapeIter and is the reason plain getArcIter produces incorrect fills (doesn't cover the whole polygon, or fills holes).

      Parameters

      • shapes: readonly (FeatureShape | null | undefined)[]

        shapes configures drawPolygonFill. Required; omission is not allowed for this API call. Valid value must satisfy the typeOperator TypeScript type and any documented string, number, boolean, array, CRS, GeoJSON, TopoJSON, CSV, Parquet, or Arrow constraints for drawPolygonFill.

      • arcs: ArcCollection

        arcs configures drawPolygonFill. Required; omission is not allowed for this API call. Valid value must satisfy the ArcCollection TypeScript type and any documented string, number, boolean, array, CRS, GeoJSON, TopoJSON, CSV, Parquet, or Arrow constraints for drawPolygonFill.

      • fillColor: string

        fillColor configures drawPolygonFill. Required; omission is not allowed for this API call. Valid value must satisfy the string TypeScript type and any documented string, number, boolean, array, CRS, GeoJSON, TopoJSON, CSV, Parquet, or Arrow constraints for drawPolygonFill.

      • Optionalfilter: (i: number) => boolean

        filter configures drawPolygonFill. Optional; when omitted or undefined, the API uses its documented default behavior. Valid value must satisfy the object TypeScript type and any documented string, number, boolean, array, CRS, GeoJSON, TopoJSON, CSV, Parquet, or Arrow constraints for drawPolygonFill.

      • Optionalopacity: number

        Multiplier on top of fillColor 's own alpha. 1 (default) leaves the colour as-is; 0.5 halves the resulting alpha. Matches MapLibre's fill-opacity semantics, independent of the colour's own alpha. opacity configures drawPolygonFill. Optional; when omitted or undefined, the API uses its documented default behavior. Valid value must satisfy the number TypeScript type and any documented string, number, boolean, array, CRS, GeoJSON, TopoJSON, CSV, Parquet, or Arrow constraints for drawPolygonFill.

      • options: PolygonFillOptions = {}

        options configures drawPolygonFill. Optional; when omitted or undefined, the API uses its documented default behavior. Valid value must satisfy the PolygonFillOptions TypeScript type and any documented string, number, boolean, array, CRS, GeoJSON, TopoJSON, CSV, Parquet, or Arrow constraints for drawPolygonFill.
